note: Flux-integrated total cross section for ν_μ charged-current single π0 production on argon, measured with the MicroBooNE LArTPC exposed to the Booster Neutrino Beam (BNB) at Fermilab. Single-value (not differential) result; flux integrated over 0-3 GeV neutrino energy. Value found in main.tex line 139: ⟨σ⟩_Φ = 1.9 ± 0.2 (stat) ± 0.6 (syst) × 10^-38 cm^2/Ar. Flux integration range (0-3 GeV) found at main.tex line 125. Target: per Ar (per argon nucleus) — paper explicitly quotes units cm^2/Ar and describes FSI scaling as A^(2/3) at the nucleus level.
